title: feat: add Mirelo SFX 2.0 to add sound to videos
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added paid-only Mirelo SFX 2.0 (`mirelo/sfx-2.0`) to the video endpoint. Supply exactly one `reference_videos` URL and a sound prompt to return the source video with synchronized sound effects, retaining its dimensions. It processes up to the first 120 seconds by default; `duration` can request less. Pricing is per returned second. Requests with missing or multiple source videos, or image inputs, return HTTP 400. Enter also gains a Mirelo AI logo for model information. No fallback provider is configured.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over warm cream, prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
